resumeText:
Ananya Kulkarni | Pune | ananya.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Legal Associate, Sahyadri Agritech Pvt Ltd, Pune (2022 - present)
- Draft and vet vendor, distribution and service agreements for the procurement and sales teams.
- Review and redline customer contracts against the company's standard positions.
- Negotiated liability caps and payment terms with counterparties on 30+ agreements.
- Prepare research notes on Indian Contract Act issues such as indemnity and termination.
- Coordinate with external counsel on 12 pending consumer and recovery disputes.
- Work with sales, finance and operations heads to close contracts within agreed timelines.

Associate, Deshmukh & Rao Advocates, Pune (2021 - 2022)
- Researched case law on SCC Online for commercial and consumer disputes.
- Assisted partners on legal due diligence for two private equity investments.

EDUCATION
BA LLB, ILS Law College, Pune, 2021

SKILLS
Contract drafting, Companies Act 2013, MS Word, SCC Online
